Future<void> carried(items, client) async {
  var cursor = initial();
  while (true) {
    for (final item in items) {
      cursor = await client.next(item, cursor);
    }
  }
}

Future<void> separate(items, client) async {
  var cursor = initial();
  while (true) {
    for (final item in items) {
      cursor = await client.next(item, cursor);
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await client.save(item);
    }
  }
}
